summary: Backend smoke test for PaskamerPraat v60.1.35 stability audit. All 8 pytest tests passed against the external URL https://paskamer-stability.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified /api/ health, /api/status GET+POST with persistence, /api/admin/generate-image returns 403 with no/wrong X-Admin-Secret, CORS preflight from foreign origin returns 204 with proper ACA-* headers, and CORS spec-compliance fix is correct (ACA-Origin='*' and NO ACA-Credentials='true' header — the v60.1.35 fix works as intended).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 174: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside generate_image (line 147). If image generation raises a non-HTTPException before logger init at import time, this would be NameError. Move logging.basicConfig + logger = ... to the top of the file (right after imports) to prevent any forward-reference risk.

server.py line 161-167: CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router). Starlette/FastAPI middleware order is generally LIFO and should be added before routes are mounted for predictable behavior; works in practice here but is fragile.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager.
POST /api/status returns 200 instead of 201 Created — minor REST style nit, not breaking.
test_credentials: ADMIN_GEN_SECRET present in /app/backend/.env — only used to verify 403 wrong-secret path; real secret never sent.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed status records created in MongoDB (TEST_test-audit, TEST_cors-check). Safe to ignore; can be purged via db.status_checks.delete_many({client_name: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints healthy. CORS v60.1.35 fix confirmed via curl: OPTIONS preflight returns HTTP/2 204 with ACA-Origin='*' and NO ACA-Credentials header — spec compliant. PWA frontend lives in /app/pwa/ (not served by preview URL); skip frontend testing in this environment.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. v60.1.35 stability audit CORS fix verified working: when CORS_ORIGINS='*' the middleware correctly forces allow_credentials=False, avoiding the browser-rejected 'credentials true with wildcard' combination.
